modules.name: e.crypto.kx
modules.comment: `e.crypto.kx` post-quantum entries: ML-KEM-768 with keys, ciphertexts and shared secrets equal to kyber-py including implicit rejection, ML-DSA-44 keys and deterministic signatures equal to dilithium-py with malformed hints refused, XMSS (RFC 8391) against a byte-level replica at height four in the fixture and height ten once, SHAKE128/256 against hashlib

modules.name: e.test.coverage
modules.comment: `e.test.coverage` planned functions: block, branch and MC/DC coverage from counters, grammar-based generation and hierarchical delta debugging, golden files with a Myers diff, normalised snapshots, fault injection plans over readers and writers, HTTP cassettes recorded and replayed

modules.name: e.mem
modules.comment: `e.mem` planned functions: pool, slab and buddy allocators over caller storage (offsets, checked against a replica), a backoff spin lock, an epoch-based RCU cell with four readers seeing no retired index, and the mmap `map`/`unmap` names; the C bootstrap still builds the compiler

modules.name: e.gpu
modules.comment: `e.gpu` planned kernels on the CPU backend: a bitonic sorting network launched once per stage and pass over a device buffer, and a tiled online-softmax attention within 1e-4 of numpy with the tile count visible
